title: Same-site browser API
responsibility: Create browser request helpers for the hub API using the existing same-origin session cookie.

inputs.name: browserApi.fetcher
inputs.description: Fetch implementation used for each request. Defaults to the global fetch function; the helper supplies the same-origin credentials, no-store cache, headers, body, and timeout options.

inputs.name: browserApi.failed
inputs.description: Callback invoked for each non-OK HTTP response with an Error carrying its status and code. Defaults to a no-op and is not called when fetching itself rejects.

outputs.name: browserApi
outputs.description: Object of asynchronous GET, POST/DELETE, media, and byte request helpers. Paths must begin with /api/; GET query values that are empty or otherwise falsy are omitted, JSON writes use same-origin credentials and no-store caching, and requests use a 30-second timeout.

errors.name: Browser API path, transport, or response failure
errors.description: Rejects non-API paths, coded HTTP failures, network/timeouts, invalid response JSON and media read failures. HTTP failures include status/code and readable wording.
